name: A Life Worth Living
source:
As a player, you take control of Fred (or name of your choice), an Ex-Military. He is happily married but has been through many ups and downs in his life. You'll be a part of this journey as you make important decisions on his behalf.

[From F95Zone]
translation:
作为一名玩家，你控制弗雷德（或你选择的名字），一名退伍军人。他的婚姻很幸福，但他的生活却经历了许多坎坷。当你代表他做出重要决定时，你将成为这段旅程的一部分。

[来自F95Zone]
